release_notes: Version grammar is now strictly X.Y or X.Y.Z (base-10 integer segments); a bare single integer like "1" is no longer treated as a version
validate_version() now requires an exact match: strings with trailing or leading garbage ("1.0.0abc", "1.0beta", "v1.0") are correctly rejected instead of matching on a valid-looking prefix

sort_versions() and get_last_version() now compare differing-length versions ("1.0" vs "1.0.0") as numerically equal and break ties deterministically by the version string itself, instead of depending on input or filesystem order
available_versions() no longer collapses every unparseable name onto a shared blank "" key; unparseable entries are filtered out of the result instead
get_last_version() now raises a clear, documented ValueError when no valid version is found or when neither versions_list nor versions_path is given, instead of an incidental IndexError/TypeError

extract_version(pattern=...) now has a fully documented error contract: a pattern with zero or more than one capture group raises PatternArityError, invalid regex syntax raises re.error, and everything else that fails to find a version returns ""
The CLI's exit-code contract is now explicit and documented: 0 for full success, 1 for a semantic or partial failure, 2 for missing/invalid input - visible in extract-version --help
extract/validate keep their partial-success behavior for multi-name calls (valid results still print, one stderr line per failure), now formally part of the documented contract

Fixed available's output (both plain-text and --json) to sort by the same numeric version-sort rule as the rest of the library, instead of lexicographically by string, so "1.9" now correctly precedes "1.10"

A bad --path on available/last-version (a nonexistent path, a file instead of a directory, or a permission error) now fails cleanly with a friendly message and exit code 1, instead of printing a raw Python traceback
README now documents the full grammar contract, a Compatibility Policy section, and the CLI's output-format and pattern-error contracts
Test suite significantly expanded: test/test_extract_version.py grew from 9 to 45 tests, test/test_cli.py from 17 to 60 tests
Move S3 uploads to the shared packages-s3-useast1-any bucket, under an extract-version/ prefix
Update the AWS mirror link accordingly
